widgets_values:
Higher res = higher quality, to a point.

My 4090 can support output of around 1280 base resoltuion.

Chaarcter ref image needs to face forward, standing upright, hands to side, feet together. Doesn't need to be ironclad.

Higher the res the better.

Find the models on the OneFrame github: https://github.com/xhiroga/ComfyUI-FramePackWrapper_PlusOne

The body2img and photo2char loras are here:
https://huggingface.co/tori29umai/FramePack_LoRA/tree/main

The fp-1f-kisekae-1024-v4-2 lora is here:
https://huggingface.co/kohya-ss/misc-models/blob/main/fp-1f-kisekae-1024-v4-2-PfPHEMA.safetensors
If you have Triton installed, connect this for a speed increase

The lora and the model should not change if you want the body to image functionality.

There are other similar loras to try though. Tweak at your leasure.

The pose image supports a wide vareity of pose images. It can be simple black line sketch, grey models, or a combination.

For details, go here (its in Japanese): https://note.com/tori29umai/n/n3447ca5b1437

body2img_V7 - reposes char to lineeart / 3d doll pose.
Convert reference images of poses and expressions into character design images.

photo2chara_V6 - reposes char to photo pose, no bg.
Converts photos of people into anime-style character illustrations. Not only the drawing style, but also facial features, body type, clothing, hairstyle, etc. are converted, and the background is changed to a simple white.

photo2chara_V12 - repose char to photo pose, no bg, no prop.
Converts photos of people into anime-style character illustrations. Not only the drawing style, but also facial features, body type, clothing, hairstyle, etc. are converted.

photo2chara_V13_000180 - repose char to photo pose, keeps bg.
Converts photos of people into anime-style character illustrations. Not only the drawing style, but also facial features, body type, clothing, hairstyle, etc. are converted.

fp-1f-kisekae-1024-v4-2 - reclothes char to the clothing image. Detailed short clothing description is vital!
The girl stays in the same pose, but her outfit changes into a <costume description>, then she changes into another girl wearing the same outfit.

If you have sage attention, use that.

Otherwise, default ot sdpa/
